The '''Gungan military launching ship''' was a long narrow submersible that could navigate the underwater caverns deep in the Naboo seas. They were developed after the Gungan's war with the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] as a quick way to transport troops.

==Description==
The submersible was long and thin. The skin of the outer hull was made out of a blue mineral that helped to camouflage them in the water. They carried numerous warriors.

==History==
They were used to surprise an imperial battalion when [[Ferus Olin]] and [[Fy-Tor-Ana|Solace]] led a combined Gungan/Naboo militia against [[Malorum]] and his forces. The surprise attack by the Gungans lead to a complete routing of the imperial battalion.
